summary: Web Push Notifications E2E testing completed. All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend UI components present and functional. Push subscription flow correctly implemented with proper error handling.

critical.issue: DUPLICATE ROUTE CONFLICT: There are two different route handlers for /push/status (lines 818 and 4628) and /push/test (lines 872 and 4641) in server.py. The first one handles FCM mobile tokens, the second handles web push subscriptions. FastAPI uses the first defined route, so web push status/test endpoints are shadowed by FCM endpoints.

action_items: CRITICAL: Rename web push endpoints to avoid route conflicts. Suggested: /api/push/web/status, /api/push/web/test, or /api/push/web-status, /api/push/web-test
Update pushService.js to use the renamed web push endpoints
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has duplicate route definitions at lines 818/4628 (/push/status) and 872/4641 (/push/test). This causes web push endpoints to be inaccessible.
The frontend pushService.js correctly calls /push/status for web push but receives FCM status response due to route conflict
